projects.title: Personal Finance Dashboard | UI/UX Case Study
projects.description: Ledgr is a calm personal-finance dashboard designed around one question: "Am I okay this month?" One hero number, honest comparisons, plain-language insights and a guided 3D tour, delivered as a responsive, fully interactive prototype.

projects.title: Wanderly — Making Travel Planning Simple
projects.description: Wanderly is a modern travel discovery and planning platform designed to make trip planning simple, inspiring, and effortless. This project explores how users can discover destinations, save travel ideas, build personalized itineraries, and visualize their journeys in one seamless experience.

projects.title: Lumora - Gamified Trivia Learning App | UX Case Study
projects.description: Lumora is a mobile-first trivia platform designed to transform learning into an engaging and rewarding experience. This end-to-end UX case study covers the complete product design journey, including user research, information architecture, branding, design systems, wireframes, and high-fidelity mobile interfaces. By integrating gamification, personalized challenges, leaderboards, and a seamless reward system, Lumora encourages users to learn, compete, and grow through an intuitive and enjoyable experience.

projects.title: FlowSync — Payment & Invoicing Platform (UI UX Design)
projects.description: FlowSync is a next-gen ACH payment and invoicing platform designed to streamline financial operations for SMBs. From secure logins to automated invoicing and fraud control, FlowSync puts users back in control of their payments.

projects.title: TravelSphere - Branding & Mobile App
projects.description: TravelSphere is a travel app designed to make discovering, planning, and booking trips simple and enjoyable. With a user-friendly interface, it offers personalized destination recommendations, customizable itineraries, and a one-stop booking hub for flights, hotels, and activities. TravelSphere empowers users to explore the world confidently, providing tools to organize every travel detail in one place. Whether you're looking for adventure, romance, or cultural experiences, TravelSphere tailors suggestions to match your unique travel style, transforming travel planning into an effortless and inspiring experience.

projects.title: CoreHR - HR Management System
projects.description: CoreHR is a comprehensive Human Resource Management System (HRMS) designed to streamline and enhance the efficiency of HR processes within organizations. The system aims to provide a user-friendly interface for both HR professionals and employees, facilitating seamless management of various HR functions, including scheduling, task management, performance tracking, and employee engagement.

projects.title: MedConnect - Healthcare Management Portal
projects.description: To streamline communication and coordination between healthcare providers, patients, and support staff by providing an intuitive platform for managing appointments, patient data, and medical reports.

projects.title: Crimson Arch - Web Design and Branding
projects.description: To promote and provide information about pre-construction apartments equipped with home automation technology, targeting couples looking for modern, elegant living spaces. The website will focus on showcasing the unique features and benefits of these high-tech homes while maintaining an aesthetic that conveys both elegance and kindness.

projects.title: Unity - Banking App and Branding
projects.description: Unity Bank aimed to redefine digital banking by creating a mobile app that is as simple as it is powerful. The goal was to design an app that not only meets the financial needs of users but also fosters trust and accessibility for everyone.
